content.text: /ext:medcp What is the current prevalence of multiple sclerosis in our adult population?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_code, standard_concept, domain_id, invalid_reason
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%multiple sclerosis%'
  AND domain_id = 'Condition'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept = 'S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_name
LIMIT 25

I’ll compute this from the OMOP tables using the standard MS concept and descendants, with adults defined as age ≥18 as of today.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_persons,
       SUM(CASE WHEN DATEFROMPARTS(year_of_birth, COALESCE(month_of_birth, 7), COALESCE(day_of_birth, 1)) <= DATEADD(year, -18, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adults_ge_18
FROM omop.person

SELECT MIN(observation_period_start_date) AS min_obs_start,
       MAX(observation_period_end_date) AS max_obs_end,
       COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS persons_with_observation_period
FROM omop.observation_period

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS adult_ms_cases_ever
FROM omop.person p
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = p.person_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 374919
  AND DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth, 7), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth, 1)) <= DATEADD(year, -18, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS adults_active_current
FROM omop.person p
JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = p.person_id
WHERE DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth, 7), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth, 1)) <= DATEADD(year, -18, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
  AND op.observation_period_start_date <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
  AND op.observation_period_end_date >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)

WITH cutoff AS (
  SELECT MAX(observation_period_end_date) AS as_of_date FROM omop.observation_period
), adult_active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id
  FROM omop.person p
  JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = p.person_id
  CROSS JOIN cutoff c
  WHERE DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth, 7), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth, 1)) <= DATEADD(year, -18, c.as_of_date)
    AND op.observation_period_start_date <= c.as_of_date
    AND op.observation_period_end_date >= c.as_of_date
), adult_ms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT aa.person_id
  FROM adult_active aa
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = aa.person_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  CROSS JOIN cutoff c
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 374919
    AND co.condition_start_date <= c.as_of_date
)
SELECT c.as_of_date,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_active) AS adult_population_active_at_cutoff,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_ms) AS adult_ms_cases_active_at_cutoff,
       CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_ms) AS float) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_active), 0) AS prevalence_proportion,
       100000.0 * CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_ms) AS float) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_active), 0) AS prevalence_per_100k
FROM cutoff c

content.text:
As of the latest observation-period date in the OMOP database, **2026-02-26**, the estimated adult MS prevalence is:

- **Adult population currently observed:** 256,167
- **Adults with multiple sclerosis diagnosis:** 1,990
- **Prevalence:** **0.777%**
- **Prevalence per 100,000 adults:** **776.8 per 100,000**

Method: adults were age ≥18 as of 2026-02-26; MS cases used standard OMOP concept **374919 — Multiple sclerosis** plus descendant concepts via `concept_ancestor`. Current date had no active observation periods, so I used the database’s latest observation end date as the “current” as-of date.
